name: MyRegister
description: Mark attendance in under a minute and SMS parents of absent students automatically. The platform is free.
longDescription: MyRegister is a free school register for Kenyan schools. Teachers mark present, absent, late or excused for a whole class in under a minute, and parents of absent or late students get an SMS from SAMUHIA automatically. It also manages students and classes, teacher assignments, academic years and promotion, holidays, scheduled messages and weekly and termly reports.
problem: Attendance, promotions and parent messaging depend on paper registers and repeated manual work, so absences go unreported for days.
features: One-tap daily register: present, absent, late, excused
Weekend and Kenyan public holiday aware
Automatic SMS to parents of absent or late students
SMS to a class or the whole school
Scheduled and recurring messages, with message logs
Students, classes and teacher assignments, with admin and teacher roles
Weekly and termly attendance reports with PDF export
steps: Mark the register. A full class takes under a minute, on a phone or computer.
Save it. Parents of absent or late students get an SMS from SAMUHIA straight away.
Reports build themselves from the attendance history, ready for the head teacher.

plans.name: SMS tokens
plans.description: You only pay when you message parents. The rate depends on how many you message at once.

plans.name: County or group
plans.description: For county education offices, school groups and NGOs with many schools.

priceNote: One SMS part is 140 characters. A 285-character message is 2 parts, so sending it to 10 parents uses 20 tokens. Messages are capped at 400 characters (3 parts). Library, fee collection, exams, staff and asset registers are planned for later.
priceSummary: Free platform. Pay only for SMS tokens when you message parents.
connects: SMS token top-ups by M-Pesa run through Samuhia Payments.

faq.a: Yes. The whole platform is free. You only buy SMS tokens when you want to message parents, and every new school gets 100 free.
Messages go out under the SAMUHIA name, so parents recognise them as genuine.
Yes. The register is weekend and Kenyan public holiday aware, and schools can set their own holidays.

faq.q: Can one account cover several schools?
faq.a: County and group accounts cover multiple schools with cross-school reporting. Contact us for pricing.
